system.description:
Animate one corpse as a skeleton or zombie without expending a spell slot. Each free use is one corpse, uses the spell's action and range, and needs no onyx; Undead Mastery and Soul Tax replace the spell's duration and control limits.

  • Free daily uses scale with level: 1 use (levels 1-4), 2 uses (levels 5-9), 3 uses (levels 10-14), 4 uses (levels 15-19), 5 uses (levels 20+)
  • Additional uses beyond the daily free limit require a 3rd level slot each (from 5th level)
  • Animated undead count towards your Undead Mastery cap (at most 10 undead under your control at once; 20 from 24th level) and persist until destroyed or dismissed
  • At the table: your undead act together on your initiative and move as a group. Identical undead attacking the same target roll their attacks together.
  • Soul Tax: Each dawn, you maintain undead whose combined HD total up to your Necromancer level for free (from 5th level, add your Intelligence modifier).
  • Beyond that allowance, spend spell slots to maintain controlled undead, or lose control of them.
  • Upkeep may use no more than half your total spell slots (rounded up) each dawn.
  • 1 HD (skeleton, poltergeist) — 1st level slot each
  • 2-3 HD (zombie, ghoul, shadow, rusalka) — 2nd level slot each
  • 4-5 HD (ghast, wight, wraith, allip, draugr, haunt) — 3rd level slot each
  • 6-8 HD (spectre, banshee, apparition, revenant, skeleton warrior, crypt thing) — 4th level slot each
  • 9+ HD (bodak, death knight, skull lord, bone golem) — 5th level slot each
  • Undead whose slot cannot be paid immediately break free — GM determines their behaviour
  • Command Undead: As an action, attempt to bring an uncontrolled undead within 30ft under your command, 1 + half your Necromancer level times per day.
  • Its Level cannot exceed your Necromancer level, and mindless undead save as normal.
  • Control lasts 1 hour per Necromancer level unless you pay Soul Tax for it at dawn.
  • The undead makes a Will save against your Class Save DC
  • Failed save: obeys your commands and counts towards your Undead Mastery cap
  • Successful save: no effect
  • Spell Use: Cast spells from the Necromancer spell list using standard slot progression.
  • Death Magic: The save DC of your Necromancy spells is increased by
  • Kit Ability: Gain the named abilities from your chosen Kit.

activities.name: Command Undead
